body:
I first boiled 20 grams of blue lotus for 15 minutes. I waited for it to cool down for 30 minutes. Then down the hatch.
It didn't taste that bad. I started to feel a slight opiate buzz at 15 minutes, and had mild dry mouth going on, but no obvious pupil constriction as opiates do. After 30 minutes I peaked. And came down 30 minutes after that.  The high reminded me of taking 1 tramadol. I would give this plant 1 out of 10 on a buzz scale.
